title: Law to guarantee sick leave for app delivery workers
summary: This bill would require delivery services to give contracted delivery workers a minimum amount of unpaid safe and sick time, starting with 14 hours upon hire and accruing 1 additional hour for every 30 hours worked. Workers could use this time for health, safety, caregiving, domestic violence related or other urgent needs, and companies could not lower their work access or ratings because of it. Companies could require documentation only if a worker uses an hour or more of safe/sick time across 4 or more consecutive shifts, and must give 30 days' notice before updating performance metrics.
